review_scope: Static review of the supplied launcher, documentation, and MiniMax evidence receipts; no runtime commands, inference, or custom-agent selection were executed by this reviewer.
checked_classes: Observed ABI mismatch — the npm JavaScript mcode entry is resolved from PATH and launched with the adjacent Node executable; that directory is prepended to the child PATH.

Environment leakage and harness regressions — MiniMax receives a copied environment with project MINIMAX_DATA_DIR and its adjusted PATH; the other harnesses retain their existing launch paths and arguments.

Argument forwarding and project location — the resolved mcode JavaScript path precedes forwarded native arguments, and the launcher derives the repository working directory and project data directory from import.meta.url.
Runtime availability overclaims — README explicitly leaves native custom-agent selection and inference unverified; model-policy leaves custom-role execution and provider readiness unverified.

Contradictory verification evidence — the explicit Node 24 provider exit code is distinguished from the timed-out launcher probe; both receipts preserve the launcher timeout, and minimax-installed.json explicitly marks project provider readiness unresolved.

Scope and credential boundary — the launcher changes executable selection and child environment only; the supplied documentation forbids copying global credentials, and the receipts contain no credentials.
limitations: The bounded launcher provider probe timed out, so successful provider startup through this launcher remains unproved.
No inference or native selection of the ten custom agents is established by this review.
Review used a fresh-context same-family fallback, not a different-family judge.
